notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • fdefaeaf - PLDM: Fixed the extra ';' error
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/21629/diffs?diff_id=1514690876&start_sha=dd133c1096dc4199e12c7d76d5995de9c637b959)

Can you look this warning ?

```
packet-pldm.c hf_fwu_pend_ver_str_len : - filter "pldm.fwu.act_ver_str_len" appears 2 items before - labels are "ActiveComponentImageSetVersionStringLength" and "PendingComponentImageSetVersionStringLength"
Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-pldm.c:1215 proto_tree_add_item called for FT_STRING field "hf_fru_record_field_value"  - with bad encoding - "ENC_BOM" - {'ENC_ISO_8859_7', 'ENC_ISO_8859_12', 'ENC_UTF_8', 'ENC_UCS_4', 'ENC_ASCII_7BITS', 'ENC_WINDOWS_1251', 'ENC_3GPP_TS_23_038_7BITS_UNPACKED', 'ENC_ETSI_TS_102_221_ANNEX_A', 'ENC_GB18030', 'ENC_3GPP_TS_23_038_7BITS', 'ENC_T61', 'ENC_EBCDIC', 'ENC_APN_STR', 'ENC_MAC_ROMAN', 'ENC_ISO_8859_13', 'ENC_ISO_8859_9', 'ENC_KEYPAD_ABC_TBCD', 'ENC_DECT_STANDARD_8BITS', 'ENC_BIG_ENDIAN', 'ENC_UCS_2', 'ENC_ASCII', 'ENC_ISO_8859_1', 'ENC_ISO_8859_2', 'ENC_BCD_SKIP_FIRST', 'ENC_WINDOWS_1252', 'ENC_BCD_ODD_NUM_DIG', 'ENC_ISO_646_BASIC', 'ENC_ISO_8859_3', 'ENC_CP855', 'ENC_KEYPAD_BC_TBCD', 'ENC_ISO_8859_6', 'ENC_EBCDIC_CP037', 'ENC_ISO_8859_16', 'ENC_CP866', 'ENC_WINDOWS_1250', 'ENC_ISO_8859_14', 'ENC_ISO_8859_8', 'ENC_EBCDIC_CP500', 'ENC_BCD_DIGITS_0_9', 'ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN', 'ENC_DECT_STANDARD_4BITS_TBCD', 'ENC_ISO_8859_10', 'ENC_ISO_8859_5', 'ENC_ISO_8859_11', 'ENC_ISO_8859_4', 'ENC_CP437', 'ENC_ISO_8859_15', 'ENC_EUC_KR', 'ENC_UTF_16'} allowed
Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-pldm.c:1458 proto_tree_add_item called for hf_fwu_comp_act_method  -  item type is FT_UINT16 but call has len 4
```

and squash your change ?

Hi @AndersBroman,

Thanks for pointing out those, I am working on them.

Hi @AndersBroman ,
 
The "ENC_BOM" had been introduced by:
https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/commit/1744ce4a0f3af5adef40a19afcede29dd9c57e0c

epan: Add ENC_BOM modifier for UTF-16, UCS-2, UCS-4

Should it be removed as it caused warning?

Thanks a lot.

I did some wrong git operations, please let me close this merge request and to create a new one in the near future, thanks a lot.
